title: Sunday Service Motor Co.
venue_description:
About Sunday Service Motor Co.

Sunday Service Motor Co. is a vibrant performance venue located in Albuquerque that has become a cornerstone of the local music scene. The venue hosts weekly open mic nights organized in partnership with Rock 101 Music Academy providing a platform for musicians of all ages and skill levels to showcase their talents.

Open Mic Programming

Every Tuesday evening from 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM the venue transforms into a welcoming stage for performers. The open mic is truly all-ages making it a unique opportunity for young musicians to gain performance experience alongside seasoned players. Participants are encouraged to bring their talent while the venue provides professional equipment including a PA system keyboard microphone and inputs for instruments.

Venue Atmosphere

The space offers a supportive and dynamic environment designed to help performers feel comfortable and confident. The venue's commitment to nurturing talent is evident in their partnership with Rock 101 Music Academy which brings music education expertise to the programming.

Equipment and Facilities

Musicians benefit from professional-grade sound equipment including a full PA system keyboard and multiple input options. This comprehensive backline support allows performers to focus on their craft rather than worrying about technical requirements.

title: Sandia Music and Sound
venue_description:
About Sandia Music and Sound

Sandia Music and Sound represents a unique concept in Albuquerque's music scene - a locally owned instrument store that doubles as a performance venue through their innovative Sandia After Dark program. Located on the west side of Albuquerque this establishment has become a community hub for musicians of all ages and skill levels.

Store Overview

As a full-service music store Sandia Music and Sound offers an extensive range of musical instruments for both purchase and rental. Their inventory spans from guitars and pianos to brass and woodwind instruments. The store prides itself on flexible rental plans that accommodate musicians at every stage of their journey from beginners to experienced players.

Expert Staff and Services

The knowledgeable staff consists entirely of passionate musicians who provide personalized service to help customers find their perfect sound. Beyond sales the store offers expert repair services and personalized music lessons tailored to individual goals and skill levels.

Sandia After Dark

After store hours the venue transforms into Sandia After Dark a performance space that showcases local live music. This dual-purpose approach creates a unique environment where musicians can shop for instruments by day and perform at night.

Open Mic Events

Monthly open mic nights occur on the last Friday of each month from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM. These events welcome performers across all genres - whether acoustic indie or anything in between. The all-ages policy ensures that young musicians have opportunities to develop their performance skills in a supportive environment. Events are free to attend making them accessible to the entire community.

Community Impact

More than just a retail space Sandia Music and Sound has established itself as a vital part of Albuquerque's music community. Their mission centers on inspiring creativity fostering a love for music and helping every customer find their perfect sound. The combination of retail lessons repairs and performance opportunities under one roof creates a comprehensive musical ecosystem.

title: Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub - Pub 3
venue_description:
About Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub - Pub 3

Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub's downtown location on 2nd Street represents the third expansion of this successful Albuquerque brewery concept. The pub combines craft beer wood-fired pizza and live music into a distinctive experience that has earned recognition as a top destination for seeing favorite local bands and late-night eats.

Music Programming

The venue features live music Monday through Saturday with diverse programming that ranges from single solo performers to full 5-piece blues bands. Musical styles span western music to smooth jazz blues to folk creating an eclectic mix that appeals to varied tastes. The Spiral Pilots host a weekly open mic every Wednesday night from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM providing a platform for local musicians to perform.

The Spiral Pilots

As the resident hosts for Wednesday open mics The Spiral Pilots bring their own musical expertise to create a welcoming environment for performers. They also host Tuesday night open mics at the Rio Rancho location demonstrating their commitment to supporting the local music scene across multiple venues.

Craft Beer Selection

Blue Grasshopper features an impressive wall of approximately 90 different beers showcasing New Mexico craft breweries and other selections. The extensive beer menu provides options for every preference from light ales to heavy stouts.

Food Menu

The pub serves wood-fired pizza as their signature offering along with great salads and sandwiches. The casual dining options complement the relaxed brewery atmosphere perfectly.

Atmosphere

The venue maintains a casual laid-back atmosphere that puts guests at ease. The smaller intimate space creates perfect conditions for enjoying live music while sampling craft beers and food. The combination of good beer quality food and live local music has made it a favorite gathering spot.

Awards and Recognition

Blue Grasshopper has been recognized in Best of Albuquerque rankings including top 5 placements for Best Late Night Eats and Best Place to See Your Favorite Local Band reflecting their strong community presence.

title: Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub - Pub 2
venue_description:
About Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub - Pub 2

The Riverside Plaza location of Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub serves as the second expansion of this popular Albuquerque brewery chain. Opened in 2017 this location continues the tradition of combining craft beer excellent food and live music that made the original location successful.

Open Mic Programming

Every other Monday night from 6:00 PM to 9:30 PM Rob Roman hosts open mic sessions at this location. These bi-weekly events provide opportunities for local musicians to perform in a supportive brewery environment. Check their calendar for exact dates as the schedule alternates weekly.

Rob Roman

Host Rob Roman is a fingerstyle percussive guitarist who has developed his own unique take on this unusual style of playing. He uses intricate picking and percussive tapping techniques to take audiences on musical journeys. His music is rooted in folk and blues but also incorporates influences from the UK underground dance music scene where he spent 15 years as a dance music producer in Bristol. This combination of diverse styles creates a beautiful and unusual sound.

Live Music Schedule

Beyond open mics the venue features live music Monday through Saturday with performers representing various genres. The eclectic programming includes everything from acoustic solo acts to full bands covering blues western jazz and folk styles.

Brewery and Food

The location offers the full Blue Grasshopper experience with New Mexico craft beer wine and a complete food menu. Wood-fired pizzas remain a specialty along with salads and sandwich options. The casual atmosphere makes it ideal for both dining and entertainment.

Venue Space

The Riverside Plaza location provides ample space for both music performances and dining. Guests can enjoy quality craft beer while listening to local talent in a relaxed brewery setting.
location: 6163 Riverside Plaza Lane NW Albuquerque NM 87120

title: Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub - Pub 1
venue_description:
About Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub - Pub 1

The original Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub location in Rio Rancho established the foundation for what has become a successful three-location brewery operation. Started with a small location the pub has grown to become a beloved destination for craft beer live music and quality food in the Rio Rancho area.

Sunday Open Mic

Every Sunday afternoon from 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM Rob Roman hosts an open mic session at this location. The afternoon timing makes it particularly family-friendly and accessible allowing musicians to perform during daylight hours. This regular programming provides consistent performance opportunities for the local music community.

Tuesday Open Mic

The Spiral Pilots host an additional open mic night every Tuesday evening from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM at the Rio Rancho location. This gives the venue two weekly open mic opportunities catering to different schedules and preferences.

Rob Roman's Musical Background

Rob Roman brings extensive musical experience to his hosting duties. His fingerstyle percussive guitar technique combines intricate picking with percussive tapping creating a unique sound. His background includes 15 years in Bristol's dance music scene as a producer which he blends with folk and blues roots to create distinctive musical journeys.

Regular Live Music

Beyond open mics the venue features live music Monday through Saturday. The diverse booking includes single solo performers through 5-piece blues bands performing everything from western music to smooth jazz. This variety ensures there's always something new to experience.

Food and Drink

The Rio Rancho location serves the full Blue Grasshopper menu including wood-fired pizzas great salads and sandwiches. The craft beer selection features New Mexico breweries and other quality options. The combination of good food beer and music creates a complete entertainment experience.

Community Favorite

As the flagship location Blue Grasshopper Rio Rancho has established itself as a go-to place for locals seeking quality craft beer food and live local music. The friendly atmosphere and consistent programming have built a loyal following over the years.
location: 4500 Arrowhead Ridge Dr SE Rio Rancho NM 87124

title: Launchpad Night Club
venue_description:
About Launchpad Night Club

Launchpad Night Club stands as Albuquerque's legendary music venue having served the local music scene since its establishment in 1997. Located in the heart of downtown at 618 Central Ave SW this iconic venue has become synonymous with live music in Albuquerque earning a reputation as many locals' favorite music destination.

Venue Overview

The venue features a multi-level layout with booths downstairs arcade and pinball machines a spacious dance floor and additional seating upstairs including booths and a mezzanine overlook. This design creates multiple vantage points for enjoying performances while maintaining an intimate dive bar atmosphere.

Music Programming

Launchpad presents live music every night of the week featuring an impressive mix of national touring acts local bands and big-name performers. The venue's commitment to diverse programming means there's always something happening from punk and rock to alternative and indie performances.

Special Events

The venue hosts several annual events that have become Albuquerque traditions including the massive multi-night Night of the Living Cover Bands festival in October St. Punktrick's Day Tom Waits for Christmas and a Halloween Dance Party. These signature events draw crowds from across the region.

Venue Features

The space includes a well-stocked bar despite its dive bar aesthetic. Entertainment options beyond live music include arcade games and pinball machines adding to the casual fun atmosphere. The multi-level design with mezzanine overlook provides excellent sightlines throughout the venue.

Accessibility and Policies

Most shows are 21 and older with ID required though some events are marked as all-ages. The venue is equipped for handicap accessibility. Free parking is available in the lot across the street and behind the venue. Box office opens 2 hours prior to show time and accepts cash payments.

Atmosphere

Cool dive bar vibes combined with a surprisingly well-stocked bar create a unique environment. The venue successfully balances its casual approachable atmosphere with professional-quality sound and lighting for performances. This combination has made it a favorite among both musicians and music fans in Albuquerque.

title: Sister Bar
venue_description:
About Sister Bar

Sister Bar has established itself as a vital part of Albuquerque's downtown music scene located at 407 Central Ave NW. This intimate venue with a capacity of 360 people offers a unique combination of live music bar service restaurant fare and pinball creating a distinctive entertainment experience in the heart of the city.

Music Programming

The venue maintains an impressive concert schedule featuring a diverse range of artists from indie rock and alternative to metal blues jazz and experimental music. Sister has hosted notable acts including The Sword Swollen Members AJJ blackwater holylight and Chris Cohen among many others. The venue's eclectic booking policy ensures variety with touring national acts and strong local talent sharing the stage.

Performance Quality

Sister Bar is renowned for its excellent sound quality which enhances the intimate concert experience. Musicians and fans alike praise the venue's professional audio setup and attentive staff. The relatively small capacity creates an up-close personal atmosphere where audiences can truly connect with performers.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The bar offers craft cocktails quality drinks and food service in a welcoming environment. Pinball machines add a vintage entertainment element that complements the venue's character. The space maintains a casual yet engaging vibe that appeals to music enthusiasts and casual visitors alike.

Local Music Support

Sister Bar actively supports Albuquerque's local music scene providing a platform for area bands and musicians. The venue has hosted album release shows and special events for local acts demonstrating commitment to the community's musical talent. This support for homegrown artists alongside touring acts creates a balanced programming approach.

Venue Details

Operating hours are Tuesday through Saturday from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM and Sunday through Monday from 5:00 PM to midnight. The venue is cash-free operating on card payments only. Age restrictions apply for most shows so checking ahead is recommended to ensure all guests meet entry requirements.

Location and Accessibility

Situated in downtown Albuquerque Sister Bar is easily accessible with nearby parking options. The Central Avenue location puts it in the heart of the city's entertainment district making it convenient for locals and visitors exploring downtown nightlife.

title: Founders Speakeasy
venue_description:
About Founders Speakeasy

Founders Speakeasy embodies the spirit of the Prohibition era in downtown Albuquerque offering a hidden gem experience nestled beneath the historic El Rey Theater at 622 Central Ave SW. Established in 2019 this speakeasy creates an authentic clandestine atmosphere where history and mixology intertwine.

The Speakeasy Experience

To enter Founders guests must walk into what appears to be a typical liquor store then provide a special password available online or through Instagram. This leads through an inconspicuous freezer door to reveal an intimate underground bar with vintage decor dim lighting and black-and-white checkered walls. The password entry adds a fun theatrical element to each visit.

Cocktail Program

The highlight of Founders lies in its carefully crafted drink menu featuring the finest craft cocktails in New Mexico. Expert mixologists prepare an impressive selection of handcrafted cocktails ranging from classic speakeasy staples like the Old Fashioned and Sazerac to unique signature creations. The most popular drink is the Banana Bread Old Fashioned which has achieved legendary status among regulars. Other notable cocktails include the San Francisco Pisco Punch and There's No Moon both perfectly balanced creations.

Atmosphere

The cozy nostalgic vibe hums with lively chatter and exceptional service. The intimate space creates perfect conditions for conversation while the chic decor pays homage to the Prohibition era. The EZ band provides musical entertainment adding to the authentic speakeasy ambiance.

Service and Staff

The friendly knowledgeable bartenders including Brandon Sergio Morgan and Josh are highly praised for their expertise and welcoming manner. They provide expert recommendations on signature cocktails and can craft any variation on classic drinks. Staff members even accommodate non-alcoholic requests offering flavored coffees and other alternatives.

Pricing and Accessibility

Despite the upscale cocktail program Founders maintains reasonable prices making it accessible to a broad audience. The venue operates Tuesday through Saturday from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM and Sunday through Monday from 5:00 PM to midnight. As a cash-free establishment all payments are made by card.

Special Events

The speakeasy hosts movie nights and other special events adding variety to the regular cocktail service. These themed evenings provide unique entertainment opportunities in the intimate underground setting.
